articles.title: .NET MAUI 11 Makes CoreCLR the Default Runtime and Adds Incremental XAML Hot Reload
articles.text:
Microsoft released .NET 11 on 10 November, and .NET MAUI in .NET 11 changes the default runtime from Mono to CoreCLR on all supported platforms. It also adds incremental XAML hot reload, implicit XAML namespaces and new test project templates. The work spanned seven previews and a release candidate, and the documentation describes product quality as the release's focus. Overall, this release consolidates more than it expands.
.NET MAUI (Multi-platform App UI) is Microsoft's cross-platform UI framework for Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst and Windows apps built from one C# and XAML codebase. .NET 11 is a Standard Term Support release with two years of support. Microsoft notes that MAUI follows its own support policy, separate from the runtime's STS and LTS lifecycle.
The runtime switch is the most significant change. According to Microsoft, CoreCLR puts mobile and desktop apps on the same runtime as the other .NET workloads. Release builds use composite partial ReadyToRun by default. On Apple platforms, which disallow JIT compilation, code that isn't precompiled runs in the CoreCLR interpreter. Native AOT is an opt-in publishing option, and its Android support is still experimental. Microsoft recommends developers to test app libraries before choosing their deployment model.
XAML gets four main improvements. First, incremental hot reload, still in preview, patches live instances of pages and controls without recreating them. It is on by default in Debug builds, works with dotnet watch, and can be disabled with EnableMauiIncrementalHotReload. Second, implicit namespace declarations are now on by default, so the root xmlns and xmlns:x are optional. Third, lazy ResourceDictionary loading makes large dictionaries initialise up to roughly eight times faster when XAML source generation is used. Finally, RelativeSource bindings with a resolvable AncestorType now compile to trim-safe code.
Handlers keep replacing the legacy renderers with newer implementations. Windows uses the new CollectionView2 handler by default, Android Shell is now handler-based, and iOS and Mac Catalyst now use handlers for NavigationPage, TabbedPage and FlyoutPage. The old renderers remain available as a manual fallback. On iOS, Appearing now fires before a page is pushed rather than after it becomes visible, and secondary toolbar items move into an overflow menu. Developers who depend on the old timing should switch to NavigatedTo.
Controls get smaller additions. Maps gain clustering and custom pin icons, plus an Azure Maps-backed implementation on Windows. TabbedPage gains badges, BoxView a Fill brush, and LongPressGestureRecognizer becomes configurable. Shell also supports route templates such as trip/{tripId}.
Animation methods now accept a CancellationToken, and their non-Async variants are obsolete. On the platform side, a new Passkeys class in Microsoft.Maui.Authentication wraps WebAuthn creation and assertion, while the server still has to validate challenges and attestation. Permissions.PostNotifications now works on iOS, and splash screens can have dark-mode variants.
For Android, the minimum API level rises from 21 to 24, and x86 architecture is no longer supported. The release notes report shorter builds: an incremental build after a managed source change dropped from 68.3 to 52.3 seconds. They also report startup gains of 2.4 to 4.5 per cent from partial ReadyToRun, at the cost of a slightly larger package. Apple targets now require iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 18.2 and macOS 15.2, with Xcode 26.4.
Several changes break existing code. The Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Compatibility package no longer ships, the Color record is now sealed, Java.Lang.Object.JavaFinalize() is obsolete, and non-font SwipeItem icons are no longer tinted automatically. When upgrading, Microsoft advises to focus on throughly testing navigation, custom handlers and trimmed publishing.
The full list of changes, including per-preview release notes, is in the .NET MAUI documentation. .NET MAUI ships as a workload with NuGet packages, so a project can pin specific versions.

articles.title: ChatGPT se renueva: OpenAI dice adiós a GPT-5.6 y da paso a GPT-6.2 Sol
articles.text:
OpenAI retirará GPT-5.6 de ChatGPT el 23 de diciembre de 2026 y establecerá a GPT-6.2 Sol como modelo predeterminado. La medida afectará a quienes utilizan la versión anterior por su estilo de respuesta y su desempeño, mientras la empresa busca consolidar el nuevo sistema para solicitudes complejas y búsquedas en internet.
La compañía liderada por Sam Altman dijo en una publicación en X que cada modelo tiene un ciclo de vida y que debe retirar versiones previas para dar lugar a lanzamientos más recientes. GPT-5.6 Sol dejará de estar disponible en ChatGPT, mientras GPT-5.6 Sol y Terra saldrán de Work y Codex.
Los suscriptores de los planes Plus, Pro, Business y Enterprise conservarán el acceso durante algunas semanas adicionales para completar la transición. Una vez vencido ese período, GPT-5.6 Sol ya no podrá usarse en los servicios de OpenAI.
La sustitución llega después de otros cambios que provocaron reacciones entre los usuarios de ChatGPT. Cuando GPT-5 se lanzó en agosto de 2025, parte de la comunidad cuestionó que el modelo ofreciera respuestas más frías y pidió que se restableciera el acceso a GPT-4o.
Por qué hay críticas por el estilo de GPT-6.2 Sol de OpenAI
Cientos de publicaciones en X y Reddit pidieron que OpenAI no retire GPT-5.6 Sol. Las objeciones se concentran en la forma en que el nuevo modelo redacta y resuelve determinadas tareas.
Algunos usuarios sostienen que GPT-6 resume mucho los textos y pierde matices durante la redacción. Otros consideran que GPT-5.6 Sol ofrece resultados más confiables en ciberseguridad.
OpenAI confía en que GPT-6.2 Sol termine por ganar aceptación entre la comunidad. La empresa afirma que ajustó el modelo para gestionar solicitudes complejas, localizar información con mayor eficacia y comparar alternativas o productos.
Esa última capacidad puede aplicarse a acciones como reservar hoteles o configurar alertas para las rebajas del Black Friday. El modelo ya se despliega globalmente en la pestaña principal de ChatGPT para los abonados a Plus, Pro, Business y Enterprise.
Según las pruebas de OpenAI, GPT-6.2 Sol está preparado para temas cotidianos, instrucciones detalladas y búsquedas en la web. Su lanzamiento se produjo en noviembre de 2026 como el modelo de uso diario de la empresa.
Cómo funciona GPT-6.2 Sol de OpenAI
GPT-6.2 Sol fue concebido como un sistema de resolución ágil para servicios que requieren inmediatez, comprensión del historial y ejecución de acciones concretas. Su funcionamiento apunta a resolver procesos completos en lugar de limitarse a respuestas generales.
En ámbitos como la atención al cliente, el soporte técnico y la gestión interna, el modelo puede navegar por sistemas de administración, consultar bases de conocimiento, revisar estados en hojas de cálculo y completar tareas de varios pasos.
Ante una incidencia vinculada con un pedido o una falla técnica, Sol puede cruzar el historial del cliente, diagnosticar una causa probable y preparar o ejecutar una solución. El objetivo es reducir el tiempo que demanda ese proceso.
Qué fiabilidad tiene GPT-6.2 Sol en recordar información
El modelo cuenta con una ventana de contexto de más de un millón de tokens, unidades con las que procesa información, para conservar en una misma sesión el historial relevante de una cuenta, manuales operativos extensos o registros de incidencias. Esa capacidad busca evitar que el usuario deba repetir datos cuando cambia de canal o prolonga una conversación.
El sistema puede recordar acuerdos previos, restricciones y gestiones anteriores sin que sea necesario resumir información. Procesa texto e imágenes, así que puede interpretar capturas de pantalla de errores, fotografías de documentos o comprobantes para acelerar una resolución.
Asimismo, GPT-6.2 Sol incorpora un razonamiento dinámico que ajusta el nivel de análisis a la complejidad de cada pedido. Para consultas directas, seguimientos de trámites o validaciones rápidas, puede operar a una velocidad de hasta tres veces la de modelos más pesados.

articles.title: Black Friday: sete em cada dez consumidores já se sentiram enganados
articles.text:
Quase sete em cada dez consumidores que costumam comprar na Black Friday já se sentiram enganados em alguma aquisição durante o período promocional. O principal motivo é a maquiagem de preços, prática conhecida como “metade do dobro”, em que lojas aumentam os valores antes da data para simular descontos maiores. O resultado aparece em pesquisa do Procon-SP divulgada nesta quinta-feira (26), véspera da Black Friday de 2026.
O levantamento reuniu respostas espontâneas de 585 consumidores do Estado de São Paulo, entre 8 de outubro e 10 de novembro. Embora 91,45% dos participantes acompanhem as ofertas da Black Friday, a percepção de descontos reais é baixa: 54,58% consideram que os preços diminuem apenas parcialmente, enquanto 39,63% avaliam que, em geral, não há redução de valores.
Entre os entrevistados que acompanham as promoções, 48,97% costumam realizar compras durante a data. Desse grupo, 69,85% afirmaram já ter se sentido enganados em alguma ocasião.
Consumidor está mais atento às promoções
A pesquisa indica que os consumidores estão atentos aos preços antes de decidir uma compra. Segundo o Procon-SP, 93,5% dos participantes costumam comparar valores antes de adquirir produtos ou serviços.
A postura cautelosa também aparece diante de mensagens publicitárias que tentam acelerar decisões, como “só hoje”, “últimas unidades” e “estoque limitado”.
Quando encontram esse tipo de anúncio:
- 35,21% analisam a oferta e decidem posteriormente;
- 30,43% ignoram esse tipo de mensagem;
- 28,38% dizem que a reação depende do produto;
- 5,98% compram imediatamente por medo de perder a oportunidade.
Apesar da cautela, a influência social continua relevante: 73,33% dos entrevistados já compraram algum produto em promoção motivados pelo comportamento ou pelos comentários de outras pessoas.
Outro dado chama a atenção: 44,44% já parcelaram uma compra, acreditando que não havia cobrança de juros, e só perceberam posteriormente que o valor final era maior.
Leia mais:
- Black Friday: Saiba como não cair em golpes e economizar ainda mais
- Black Friday: 53% dos brasileiros já usam IA para comprar online
- Eletrodomésticos com IA: como não cair em armadilhas da Black Friday
O que mais pesa na decisão de compra?
Entre os consumidores que costumam comprar na Black Friday, o preço final é o fator mais importante na escolha de um produto, citado por 68,70% dos participantes desse grupo.
O percentual de desconto aparece em segundo lugar, com 12,60%, seguido pela confiança na loja ou no site, mencionada por 10,31%.
Mesmo com a desconfiança em relação às promoções, 74,43% dos consumidores que compram na data consideram a Black Friday uma oportunidade de economizar.
No comércio em geral, 68,20% dos entrevistados afirmaram que continuam comprando produtos ou serviços mesmo quando consideram os preços elevados. As principais justificativas são a necessidade de adquirir o item e a confiança na qualidade ou na marca.
Como evitar golpes e falsas promoções na Black Friday?
Com base nos resultados da pesquisa, o Procon-SP reforçou algumas recomendações para quem pretende aproveitar as ofertas:
- Compare os preços: pesquise os valores nas semanas anteriores à Black Friday e guarde registros, como capturas de tela e históricos de comparação;
- Confira o frete: verifique o custo da entrega e o prazo previsto antes de concluir o pagamento;
- Conheça seus direitos: em compras realizadas fora do estabelecimento comercial, como pela internet, o consumidor tem direito de arrependimento em até sete dias, contados a partir do recebimento do produto ou da assinatura do contrato;
- Desconfie de links suspeitos: confira se o endereço eletrônico é legítimo e procure informações sobre a empresa, como CNPJ, endereço e canais de atendimento.
A Agência Brasil também destaca uma orientação da Secretaria Nacional do Consumidor (Senacon): ofertas com preços muito abaixo dos praticados no mercado merecem atenção especial. O órgão recomenda ainda verificar se a empresa está cadastrada na plataforma Consumidor.gov.br.
A pesquisa completa do Procon-SP está disponível neste documento.
Rodrigo Mozelli é jornalista formado pela Universidade Metodista de São Paulo (UMESP) e, atualmente, é redator do Olhar Digital.

articles.title: XEBO.ai bags $10.5M funding from Emirates Growth Fund
articles.text:
XEBO.ai bags $10.5M funding from Emirates Growth Fund
The capital injection will primarily enhance XEBO voice-of-customer portfolio, expanding capability into call analytics and digital experience monitoring. A key portion of the funding will advance agentic AI.
Dubai-headquartered technology firm XEBO.ai has raised $10.5 million in Series A funding from the Emirates Growth Fund, marking the sovereign investor as its first institutional partner.
Founded in 2017 by Yash Sultania and Anand Nigam, XEBO is an AI-native experience management platform that converts customer and employee feedback into decision-ready insights. Experience management platforms help organisations capture feedback across surveys, social listening and customer journey mapping to guide strategic operational decisions.
The capital injection will primarily enhance XEBO voice-of-customer portfolio, expanding capability into call analytics and digital experience monitoring. A key portion of the funding will advance agentic AI.
Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer Yash Sultania explained that the investment enables the team to “deepen our VoC portfolio, with agentic AI at its core, and take it to customers around the world faster”.
Beyond software development, the firm plans to expand its commercial operations across the Gulf Cooperation Council region, establish a presence in the United States, and recruit senior operational leaders.
The company also intends to leverage technology integrations with partner channels such as Microsoft to widen enterprise reach. Co-founder Anand Nigam noted that the backing allows the firm to “drive technology innovation, strengthen our presence in existing markets and expand into new geographies as we scale globally”.
The experience management sector has historically been dominated by legacy global platforms, but XEBO has built traction with over 350 enterprise clients across banking, aviation, telecommunications and healthcare. Operating from offices in the United States, the UAE, India and Saudi Arabia, the company has received industry recognition from analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester.
Anshul Garg, Investment Director at Emirates Growth Fund, highlighted that XEBO managed to “build an innovative product that addresses a real market need” while demonstrating relevance alongside established global players.
The Emirates Growth Fund represents the flagship growth equity investor of the United Arab Emirates. Launched by Dr Sultan Al Jaber at Make it in the Emirates 2025 and backed by Emirates Development Bank, it stands as the only UAE sovereign fund focused exclusively on growth-stage enterprises through strategic minority equity investments.
Matthew Singh, Chief Investment Officer at Emirates Growth Fund, noted that the firm “has proven itself with leading enterprises in demanding markets” and remains “well placed to scale internationally”.

articles.title: S&P warnt Nvidia: Governance-Bedenken könnten Rating belasten
articles.text:
Wegen Governance-Bedenken: S&P erwägt Herabstufung von Nvidia
Die Ratingagentur S&P Global hat Nvidia auf „CreditWatch Negative“ gesetzt. Damit signalisiert sie eine wahrscheinliche Herabstufung der Kreditwürdigkeit. Innerhalb von 90 Tagen könnte S&P das Rating um eine Stufe senken. Derzeit bewertet die Agentur Nvidia mit AA, der dritthöchsten Note ihrer Skala.
Grund dafür ist der Rücktritt und die Rückkehr von Jensen Huang. Seine Wiedereinsetzung habe „Schwachstellen im Management- und Governance-Rahmen von Nvidia offengelegt“. Das Board kontrolliere den CEO zu wenig, kritisiert die Agentur, und einige Mitglieder säßen zu lange im Gremium. Verwaltungsratschef Harvey Jones und Investor Tench Coxe gehören dem Board seit 1993 an, Brooke Seawell seit 1997. Zudem fehle ein Nachfolgeplan für Huang, auf den Nvidia stark angewiesen sei.
Eine Herabstufung würde laut S&P voraussichtlich nur eine Stufe betragen, vorausgesetzt, es kommen keine neuen Enthüllungen oder Ermittlungen hinzu, die dem Ruf oder den Geschäftsaussichten schaden. Auch Moody’s hat den Ausblick für Nvidia wegen Governance-Bedenken von „positiv“ auf „stabil“ gesenkt, das Rating jedoch unverändert gelassen. Moody’s argumentiert sogar, Huangs Rückkehr beseitige das Risiko eines Führungswechsels, sieht aber ebenfalls offene Fragen zur Governance und Regulierung.
Nvidias Rolle als Geldgeber wird zum Risiko
Ein schlechteres Rating könnte die Kurse der Unternehmensanleihen drücken und künftige Finanzierungen verteuern. Zudem könnte es Nvidias Rolle als „Bank“ für den KI–Boom gefährden. Der Konzern agiert in der Branche auch als Geldgeber. Huang hat etwa Geschäfte mit Cloud–Anbietern wie CoreWeave vorangetrieben, die Nvidia–Chips kaufen – teils abgesichert durch Bürgschaften des Unternehmens.
Die Kosten für eine Absicherung gegen Zahlungsausfälle von Nvidia erreichten am Mittwoch einen Rekord. Gleichzeitig wächst die Sorge über die Schulden der KI–Branche. Die Absicherung von Nvidia–Anleihen über fünf Jahre verteuerte sich zeitweise bereits um bis zu sechs Basispunkte auf 147,27 Basispunkte im Jahr, wie Bloomberg berichtet.
Nach einem Kurssturz in den Vorwochen gewann Nvidia am Montag fast eine Billion Dollar an Börsenwert zurück, verlor jedoch in den folgenden Tagen wieder deutlich. Bis Mittwochabend fiel der Kurs auf 149,30 Dollar.
Elf Tage zwischen Rücktritt und Comeback
Huang trat am 12. November nach Berichten über Affären zurück. Eine betraf die Technologie–Managerin Alice Huang, die laut US–Behörden Verbindungen zum chinesischen Geheimdienst haben soll. Die andere Affäre hatte er mit einer Nvidia–Führungskraft, die ihm direkt unterstellt war.
Zunächst bewertete Board–Chef Jones Huangs Verhalten als Verstoß gegen den Verhaltenskodex und schloss eine Rückkehr aus. Doch elf Tage später setzte das Board Huang einstimmig wieder ein, nachdem sich Verbündete aus dem Silicon Valley sowie US–Präsident Donald Trump für ihn stark gemacht hatten. Huang entschuldigte sich später bei den Mitarbeitern und erklärte, er befinde sich in therapeutischer Behandlung.
Neue Ermittlungen, neue Risiken für Nvidia
Ausgestanden ist die Affäre aber noch lange nicht. US–Behörden verdächtigen Megaspeed, das Unternehmen aus Singapur, für das Alice Huang arbeitete, gegen Exportregeln verstoßen zu haben. Kommende Woche soll Jensen Huang dazu im Kongress aussagen. Ab Januar wollen die Demokraten ihre neue Mehrheit nutzen, um weitere Nachforschungen anzustellen.
Außerdem ermitteln laut „Financial Times“ die US–Börsenaufsicht SEC sowie Generalstaatsanwälte aus Missouri und Kalifornien. Hinzu kommen Sammelklagen von Anlegern gegen Huang und das Board. Präsident Trump erklärte hingegen, Justizminister Todd Blanche sehe keine Beweise für Gesetzesverstöße durch Huang.
Nvidia hat den Export von Chips nach Singapur, Malaysia, Thailand und Indonesien gestoppt. Über diese Länder soll China an fortschrittliche KI–Technik gelangt sein. Nvidia prüft nun intern, wie es die neuen US–Exportregeln künftig einhalten kann.

articles.title: Disney confirma el regreso de la animación 2D y explica cómo usará la IA en sus películas: «Puede aportar algo interesante»
articles.text:
Disney ya está lista para estrenar su nueva película, Hechizo: Bienvenidos a Hexe. De nuevo, se trata de un filme realizado con la animación 3D que desde principios de siglo la compañía trata de implementar y mejorar cada año que pasa. Sin embargo, el estudio se encuentra a las puertas de un nuevo cambio en su forma de hacer cine. Y es que Disney comenzará a utilizar Inteligencia Artificial en sus películas.
Sin ir más lejos, hace unas semanas se confirmó que Disney llegaba a un acuerdo con Adobe como su socio oficial en innovación en IA. Entre otras cosas, el gigante del software proporcionará a La Casa del Ratón acceso anticipado a sus últimas tecnologías de Inteligencia Artificial, como Adobe Firefly y Adobe Firefly Foundry.
Y precisamente en Hipertextual hemos podido hablar sobre Inteligencia Artificial en Disney con uno de los máximos responsables de Disney Animation, el productor Roy Conli (El planeta del tesoro, Enredados, Big Hero 6). "Creo que la Inteligencia Artificial es una herramienta que, a medida que evoluciona, tiene que estar en manos de un artista. Siempre tiene que estar en manos de un artista", confirma en su paso por Madrid para presentar la película Hechizo: Bienvenidos a Hexe.
"La idea de que algo se cree de la nada simplemente no me interesa", promete a su vez, desterrando la idea de que el estudio pueda prescindir de sus creativos en favor de crear películas solo con IA. "Pero si está en manos del artista, quizá pueda aportar algo interesante", sugiere en cualquier caso Conli. Es decir, en Disney están totalmente abiertos a usar la Inteligencia Artificial en sus películas, pero solo si esta está sujeta a las directrices humanas de sus trabajadores.
Vuelve la animación 2D a Disney
Al margen de la Inteligencia Artificial, Disney también se plantea otro paso en su dirección creativa en la animación. Y es que la compañía quiere recuperar la animación 2D tradicional. "Siempre formará parte de Disney Animation", nos promete Conli. De hecho, ya pueden verse algunos detalles de este cambio en Hechizo: Bienvenidos a Hexe.
"Una de las cosas que más me entusiasma de esta película es que contamos con ese prólogo realizado por Tyler Pacana, un joven animador 2D increíble. Y también va a haber un cortometraje de animación de Lilo & Stitch, titulado Lilo & Scratch, que se proyectará junto con Hechizo. Y, en cierto modo, también rinde homenaje a aquella época de la animación dibujada a mano", revela a su vez.
En realidad, el corto de Lilo & Scratch es precisamente el experimento que Disney va a usar para recuperar la animación 2D desde un enfoque más moderno. El proyecto, tal y como se confirmó hace unos días, usará una técnica híbrida que combinará un sistema de animación 3D con cel-shading integrando elementos 2D. El objetivo es poder recuperar la estética clásica de Disney sin ralentizar los procesos actuales (trabajar en 3D es más rápido y eficiente que en 2D).
"Creo que la animación en sí misma es magia", apunta por otro lado Conli sobre el propio formato de animación. Y es que «magia», es una de las palabras clave en Disney. "Una de mis definiciones de «magia» es que es algo que aparece de la nada. Y eso es lo que es la animación. Literalmente, empezamos con una página en blanco y, de repente, cuatro años después, tienes esta magnífica historia en la pantalla", celebra.
"Además, creo que la animación es realmente un medio fantástico para representar la magia, porque en ella puedes hacer cualquier cosa. Por eso, la magia siempre ha desempeñado un papel muy importante en todas las películas de Disney", sentencia. La mejor prueba de ello es Hechizo: Bienvenidos a Hexe, cuya premisa parte de que su protagonista descubre que es una bruja y tiene poderes mágicos.
Hechizo: Bienvenidos a Hexe se estrena en cines el 27 de noviembre.

articles.title: Why Nigerian companies are investing in Kenya
articles.text:
Before Aliko Dangote, Africa’s richest man, settled on Lamu, a historic town on Kenya’s coast, for his second major refinery, he considered Tanga, on the Tanzanian coast. In July, his group told Reuters that infrastructure, logistics, and market access tipped the decision in Kenya’s favour.
Then, in October, Greenview Oil Trading, an investment vehicle linked to Dangote, paid about KES 42.5 billion ($30.7 million) for almost a quarter of Kenya Pipeline Company (KPC). Both investments address different parts of the same problem. A refinery capable of processing 700,000 barrels a day needs somewhere to send the fuel. Kenya already has a network that takes it inland from the coast and into several neighbouring markets, including Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and South Sudan.
The Kenyan appeal to Nigerian firms looking for growth is showing up in very different parts of Kenya’s economy.
On November 16, Nigerian Exchange Group (NGX) disclosed it had acquired 10% of the Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE). In March, Nigerian fintech Moniepoint acquired a controlling stake in Sumac Microfinance Bank. Access Bank, which entered Kenya six years ago by acquiring Transnational Bank, is now folding that operation into National Bank of Kenya (NBK).
In each of these multimillion-dollar transactions, each buyer found an entity and a market already in place that would be expensive or slow to build from scratch.
There is a temptation to read any Nigerian investment abroad as a verdict on conditions at home. The World Bank says Nigeria’s economy strengthened in 2026, with growth recovering and higher oil prices improving its external position. It expects Kenya to grow 4.6% this year.
And the Kenyan assets these companies have pursued are fairly specific. Dangote wanted a route to fuel buyers while Moniepoint needed an entry point into deposits and small-business lending. NGX wants a stake in the business of raising and trading capital in a second East African market after Ethiopia. Kenya’s appeal lies in what each can buy there that would be difficult to build from Lagos.
What came up for sale
Kenya Pipeline was a state-owned company until Kenya’s Treasury put a 65% stake up for sale in March. Dangote’s Greenview Oil Trading came in later via a block trade, buying shares from Kenyan institutional investors, including the National Social Security Fund (NSSF). The affiliate paid about KES 9.36 ($0.072) a share, against the IPO price of KES 9 ($0.069). The purchase gives Dangote a seat on the company’s board alongside appointees of the Kenyan and Ugandan governments.
The prospectus gives a sense of the business he bought into. In the year to June 2025, about 4.1 million cubic metres of fuel came through Mombasa for onward transit, against Kenyan demand of 5.8 million cubic metres. Those volumes help explain why a refinery site matters so much.
For Moniepoint, Kenya was a market it had been trying to enter for years. An earlier attempt through payments company Kopo Kopo stalled. Its next move was to acquire 78% of Sumac, a microfinance bank licenced in 2012 that already took deposits and lent to Kenyan businesses.
In July, Moniepoint hired Rose Muturi, the former head of digital lender Branch in Kenya, to run the local operation. The company has said it wants to modernise Sumac’s systems and extend lending to more small businesses, including schools.
“We see a gap, which the mobile money players and microfinance providers have not met in terms of credit issuance and savings,” Edidiong Uwemakpan, the company’s vice-president of corporate affairs, told Business Daily, a local publication.
The choice of Sumac says something about what a Nigerian fintech can carry over to Kenya. Moniepoint knows how to sell financial services to small merchants. But in Kenya, a shopkeeper may already collect payments through M-Pesa, save with a bank, and borrow from a third provider.
Moniepoint could win the loan without winning the payments. That matters because a business’s daily receipts can tell a lender how much it can afford to repay and when it is likely to run short of cash. Sumac gives Moniepoint a place to make loans. Getting enough of a merchant’s business to make better lending decisions will take longer.
Access Bank offers a longer view of what it takes to build scale. Transnational Bank, the lender it bought in 2020, had 28 branches, including its head office. Four years later, Access agreed to buy NBK from KCB Group, in a transaction valued at $109.6 million.
“NBK has a proud legacy of serving the public sector in Kenya,” George Odhiambo, the lender’s managing director, said when the banks announced the deal in May 2025.
The acquisition now puts Access Bank among Tier I lenders, with a nationwide branch network akin to Equity Bank, KCB Group, and Co-operative Bank.
Flutterwave is reportedly looking at an East African bank of its own. The target and country have yet to be publicly identified. For a payments company, the appeal of such a deal is clear. Deposits and loans could give it more ways to earn from businesses that already use it to collect money.
Lagos stake in Nairobi
NGX’s investment is the hardest of the deals to assess. A 10% holding gives the Nigerian group exposure to the Nairobi exchange’s earnings. The bigger prize would be more business between the two markets.
A Kenyan fund might gain easier access to companies listing in Lagos. A Nigerian issuer might find buyers in Nairobi without having to put together a separate offering. The economics depend on those transactions becoming common enough to matter.
“Both markets have already shown what closer collaboration can achieve for issuers and investors, and a shareholding relationship gives that collaboration permanence,” Temi Popoola, NGX Group chief executive, said in the statement announcing the deal.
Nairobi has a reason to want more issuers and investors. Kenya’s central bank found that trading had become more concentrated among the five biggest listed companies in 2025 and the first half of 2026.
The turnover ratio rose to 8.6% in the first half of this year, largely because of a single block trade in Safaricom. Remove that transaction, and it was 3.1%. A big deal can make the market look busier for a time. An exchange earns greater liquidity when investors keep coming back to trade.

articles.title: Casi 1.000 euros de descuento en esta bici eléctrica plegable de Carrefour: ideal para moverse por ciudad sin gastar gasolina
articles.text:
Moverse por ciudad a diario sin depender del coche ni del transporte público resulta bastante más fácil con una bicicleta eléctrica plegable. Ahora, en su Black Friday (campaña que estará activa hasta el 30 de noviembre), Carrefour tiene rebajada esta Evercross EK5SA por una cifra muy competitiva para entrar en el segmento urbano. Su precio cae hasta los 529,99 euros frente a los 1.499,99 euros de precio habitual que tiene.
Bicicleta Eléctrica Plegable De 16" Evercross Ek5sa Batería Extraíble Doble Freno De Disco Aplicación Bluetooth Negro

articles.title: 1Password confirms data breach after hacker compromises employee's GitHub account
articles.text:
What we know so far: 1Password has confirmed that a hacker stole customer names and email addresses from its backend systems. The attacker compromised a single employee's GitHub account and was able to push malicious code into those services and pull customer records. The stolen data does not include passwords or anything stored in customer vaults, but it still leaves users open to convincing phishing attempts, and 1Password has not said how many people are affected.
1Password began its investigation earlier this month. By then, the intruder had used the hijacked account to browse the company's source code and insert malicious instructions designed to collect customer data.
The change was a subtle one. Code written to look like part of the normal system doesn't need to break anything, and one compromised developer login was enough to put it into production. Attacks on source repositories and build pipelines have become a common route into software companies, and this one fits that pattern.
Beyond names and email addresses, the haul included public keys and the account and user identifiers that 1Password uses internally. Public keys are designed to be shared, so exposing them doesn't hand over access to anything. The identifiers could still help someone build a more believable lure or match records to a particular customer.
The leaked data also included tokens from certain emailed invitation links and account recovery links. Those tokens are key to the account enrollment and recovery process and could, in principle, be used to start taking over an account.
But according to the company, an attacker would also need to pair a token with a single sign-on method or with a six-digit numeric code sent to the user's email. Six digits is a small space for guessing, so the company has lengthened those codes to 10 alphanumeric characters. That raises the number of possible combinations from a million to more than a trillion, which makes guessing impractical.
The company has disabled the affected GitHub account and rotated the internal credentials that the breach compromised. Rotation is standard after an intrusion like this, because any secret the attacker could have seen must be treated as compromised. It has also added a new detection system to spot similar attacks.
1Password hasn't said how the attacker got into the GitHub account in the first place. It also hasn't said how long the malicious code ran before it was found or how many customers' records were pulled. Those answers will be important to security teams deciding how much to trust the fix.
For people who use the product, the more immediate problem is social engineering. A criminal who knows a person's name and email address and knows they use 1Password, can write a message that looks routine.
1Password warns that fake emails, texts, or phone calls may reference invitations or account recovery attempts, the same events the stolen tokens relate to. A message about a recovery request that the recipient never made would be easy to take seriously.
The company has set out what it won't do. It says it will never ask customers for their account password or Secret Key, and that those should be entered only into the official 1Password app or website. That guidance is useful because a password manager's value rests on a few secrets that never leave the user's hands. A fake page that captures a master password or Secret Key would be far more damaging than the data already taken.
The incident shows how the security of a product with strong encryption can still depend on ordinary systems around it. 1Password's vault design appears to have held, since the company says vault data wasn't exposed. The attack didn't try to break that design. It went through a developer account that could change code running on the servers.
Companies that handle sensitive data have long been urged to tighten controls around code repositories, including strong authentication on developer accounts, limits on who can push to production, and review of changes before they ship. The company's new detection system points toward the last of those. Whether that is enough will depend on the details 1Password hasn't yet shared.
For now, customers should treat any unexpected message mentioning 1Password with suspicion and go straight to the official app or site rather than following a link.

articles.title: Melhor Soundbar JBL: 6 modelos para comprar em 2026
articles.text:
Melhor Soundbar JBL: 6 modelos para comprar em 2026
Confira quais soundbars da JBL valem a pena atualmente, avaliando opções de 2.1 a 11.1.4 canais, graves de subwoofer sem fio e modelos com caixas traseiras removíveis
As melhores soundbars da JBL atendem a diferentes perfis de consumidores, desde quem busca melhorar o áudio da televisão até quem deseja montar um sistema de som surround em casa. O catálogo da fabricante inclui modelos com subwoofer sem fio, caixas traseiras removíveis e alto-falantes com Dolby Atmos.
Além da potência sonora e da quantidade de canais, características como conectividade, calibração acústica e dimensões dos equipamentos devem ser consideradas na hora da compra.
Para te ajudar na decisão, o Tecnoblog selecionou seis soundbars da JBL e reuniu as principais características, vantagens e limitações de cada modelo. Confira a seguir.
A JBL Bar 1300XMK2 é uma alternativa aos sistemas de home theater tradicionais. O modelo possui sistema de 11.1.4 canais e acompanha duas caixas surround removíveis, que podem ser posicionadas atrás de um sofá — elas possuem baterias recarregáveis e podem funcionar como alto-falantes independentes.
O sistema oferece potência total de 785 W RMS e conta com um subwoofer sem fio de 12 polegadas. A soundbar é compatível com Dolby Atmos e DTS:X e possui seis alto-falantes direcionados para cima, distribuídos entre a barra e as caixas traseiras.
Nas conexões, a JBL oferece três entradas HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, com passagem de vídeo em 4K e suporte a HDR10+ e Dolby Vision, além de entrada óptica. A soundbar também possui Bluetooth 5.3 na barra principal, Bluetooth 5.4 nas caixas removíveis e Wi-Fi 6 de banda dupla (2,4 GHz e 5 GHz).
A JBL Bar 1000MK2 também traz caixas surround removíveis com baterias recarregáveis com bateria para até 10 horas, segundo a fabricante. Porém, o sistema utiliza uma configuração de 7.1.4 canais e oferece potência total de 480 W RMS — 150 W são do subwoofer sem fio de 10 polegadas.
A soundbar conta com quatro alto-falantes direcionados para cima, sendo dois na barra principal e um em cada caixa traseira, além de suporte aos formatos Dolby Atmos e DTS:X. Isso é interessante para quem busca uma reprodução de áudio espacial com canais dedicados.
O modelo mantém as três entradas HDMI presentes na Bar 1300XMK2, permitindo conectar diferentes equipamentos diretamente à soundbar. Também oferece uma saída HDMI eARC com passagem de vídeo em 4K, HDR10+ e Dolby Vision, além de entrada óptica, Bluetooth 5.3 e Wi-Fi 6.
A JBL Bar 800MK2 é para quem procura um sistema de som surround com caixas traseiras dedicadas. O modelo tem sistema de 7.1 canais e acompanha duas caixas removíveis que funcionam com baterias recarregáveis, facilitando a instalação em ambientes sem tomadas próximas.
Apesar de oferecer suporte ao Dolby Atmos e ao DTS Virtual:X, a soundbar não possui alto-falantes físicos dedicados à reprodução de efeitos de altura, diferentemente das anteriores. O sistema utiliza processamento sonoro para simular esses efeitos, enquanto as caixas traseiras são responsáveis pela reprodução surround.
A potência total é de 390 W RMS, incluindo um subwoofer sem fio de 10 polegadas e 150 W RMS. Nas conexões, o modelo oferece uma entrada HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, com passagem de vídeo em 4K e compatibilidade com HDR10+ e Dolby Vision, além de entrada óptica.
Também conta com Bluetooth 5.3, Wi-Fi 6 dual-band e integração com o aplicativo JBL One, que permite ajustar a equalização e acessar serviços de streaming de música.
A JBL Bar 500MK2 pode ser interessante para quem deseja melhorar o áudio da televisão sem precisar acomodar caixas de som atrás do sofá. O sistema de 5.1 canais oferece potência total de 375 W RMS, distribuídos entre a barra de som (225 W RMS) e o subwoofer sem fio de 10 polegadas (150 W RMS).
O modelo é compatível com Dolby Atmos e DTS Virtual:X, porém não possui alto-falantes direcionados para cima nem caixas traseiras dedicadas. O sistema utiliza processamento de áudio e a tecnologia MultiBeam 3.0 para criar a sensação de som de diferentes direções.
Além do Bluetooth 5.3, o equipamento possui Wi-Fi 6 e permite reproduzir músicas por meio de serviços e tecnologias como Spotify Connect, AirPlay, Google Cast e Tidal Connect. O conjunto inclui uma entrada óptica, uma entrada HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, com passagem de vídeo em 4K e suporte a HDR10+ e Dolby Vision.
A JBL Cinema SB595 é uma soundbar mais barata para quem busca um som com Dolby Atmos. O sistema traz configuração de 3.1.2 canais, incluindo um canal central dedicado aos diálogos e dois alto-falantes direcionados para cima.
A potência total é de 220 W RMS, sendo 100 W destinados à barra de som e 120 W ao subwoofer sem fio de 6,5 polegadas. Os alto-falantes superiores utilizam a reflexão do som no teto para reproduzir efeitos de altura, um diferencial em relação aos modelos que dependem exclusivamente de processamento digital para simular esses efeitos.
Esse modelo não acompanha caixas traseiras para a reprodução de efeitos surround, como ocorre nas soundbars mais avançadas da JBL. Ele traz uma entrada HDMI e uma saída HDMI eARC, além de entrada óptica para conexão com televisores compatíveis. Também oferece Bluetooth 5.4, mas não conta com Wi-Fi.
A JBL Cinema SB180 é para quem procura uma soundbar mais simples para substituir o áudio integrado da televisão. Ela possui configuração de 2.1 canais e potência total de 110 W RMS, distribuídos entre dois alto-falantes de 25 W RMS na barra e um subwoofer sem fio de 6,5 polegadas com 60 W RMS.
Diferentemente da SB595, o equipamento não possui canal central dedicado nem suporte ao Dolby Atmos. Os diálogos são reproduzidos pelos canais esquerdo e direito da barra. Entretanto, o modelo oferece três modos de áudio (Cinema, Música e Notícias), que ajustam a reprodução sonora.
Nas conexões, a SB180 oferece HDMI 1.4 com ARC, entrada óptica, USB para reprodução de arquivos MP3 e Bluetooth 5.3. O modelo não possui Wi-Fi nem entrada HDMI adicional para conectar consoles ou outros dispositivos diretamente à soundbar.
Para escolher a melhor soundbar JBL para seu perfil de uso, observe a conectvidade disponível, o tamanho do ambiente e outros quesitos, como a quantidade de canais do sistema, a presença ou ausência de subwoofer e a potência máxima suportada. É importante ficar atento aos seguintes critérios:
- Canais de áudio: sistemas de 2.1 canais podem atender quem busca melhorar o áudio da TV, enquanto os de 3.1 canais acrescentam um canal central dedicado aos diálogos. Configurações de 5.1 canais ou superiores são mais indicadas para quem busca uma experiência sonora envolvente em filmes, séries e jogos;
- Potência sonora: considere o tamanho do ambiente e a distância entre a soundbar e quem está assistindo. Salas maiores podem demandar sistemas com maior capacidade de reprodução sonora;
- Subwoofer: modelos com subwoofer dedicado são interessantes para quem deseja uma reprodução de graves mais presente em filmes, músicas e jogos. Opções com conexão sem fio facilitam o posicionamento no ambiente, embora ainda precisem de uma tomada para alimentação elétrica;
- Caixas surround: soundbars com caixas traseiras dedicadas favorecem a percepção de sons de diferentes direções. Modelos com caixas removíveis e baterias recarregáveis facilitam a instalação em ambientes sem tomadas próximas ao sofá;
- Conectividade: confira se a TV possui HDMI ARC ou eARC, sendo este último mais indicado para transmitir formatos de áudio de alta taxa de dados. Entradas HDMI adicionais permitem conectar consoles e outros dispositivos diretamente à soundbar;
- Recursos de áudio: tecnologias de aprimoramento de diálogos, equalização e calibração acústica permitem adequar a reprodução sonora a diferentes conteúdos e características do ambiente. Verifique também a disponibilidade de ajustes pelo aplicativo JBL One;
- Conexões sem fio: o Bluetooth facilita a reprodução de músicas diretamente do celular, enquanto a conectividade Wi-Fi permite utilizar serviços e tecnologias de transmissão de áudio pela rede doméstica, como Spotify Connect e AirPlay;
- Dimensões e instalação: verifique se a largura e a altura da barra são compatíveis com o móvel e o posicionamento da TV. Considere também o espaço necessário para acomodar o subwoofer e eventuais caixas traseiras, além da disponibilidade de tomadas no ambiente.
A JBL Bar 1300XMK2 é a mais indicada. O sistema de 11.1.4 canais combina duas caixas surround traseiras, seis alto-falantes dedicados aos efeitos de altura e um subwoofer de 12 polegadas.
O modelo também oferece calibração acústica para adequar a reprodução sonora às características do ambiente.
A JBL Cinema SB595 é uma soundbar com o melhor custo-benefício para salas pequenas, com sistema de 3.1.2 canais, subwoofer sem fio e Dolby Atmos com canais físicos de altura. Já a JBL Cinema SB180 é uma alternativa mais simples para quem prioriza a economia e deseja apenas melhorar o áudio da TV.
As JBL Bar 1300XMK2, Bar 1000MK2 e JBL SB595 possuem alto-falantes direcionados para cima, com seis, quatro e dois drivers dedicados aos efeitos de altura, respectivamente.
Diferentemente dos modelos com Dolby Atmos virtualizado, esses equipamentos utilizam a reflexão do som no teto para reproduzir os efeitos sonoros verticais.

articles.title: Infantino peut souffler : des hackers ont piraté la Fifa mais épargné son projet le plus sensible
articles.text:
Les captures d’écran circulaient depuis près d’une semaine.
La Fifa a annoncé ce jeudi 26 novembre 2026 avoir été victime d’une cyberattaque. Dans une déclaration transmise à plusieurs médias, l’instance évoque un « accès non autorisé à un ensemble limité d’informations personnelles et professionnelles ».
L’intrusion était revendiquée depuis le 19 novembre par le Handsome Boy Hacking Club, qui avait alors publié sur X une capture d’écran de fichiers liés à la Fifa. Trois jours plus tard, le groupe a semblé s’attribuer la fuite en répondant à un message affirmant que plus de 12 Go de documents internes avaient été divulgués.
Des documents d’identité et des fichiers financiers
Le groupe affirme avoir dérobé des documents d’identité, des informations sur des dirigeants, des relevés financiers, des documents juridiques et des fichiers de gouvernance interne.
La Fifa n’a confirmé ni le volume ni le contenu complet de ces données, et n’a pas précisé combien de personnes ou d’organisations étaient touchées, quand l’attaque a eu lieu ni ce que recouvrent ces informations professionnelles.
D’après la BBC, ses systèmes n’ont pas été pris en défaut, puisque les attaquants se sont introduits en se faisant passer pour des membres du personnel. Une source au fait du dossier a assuré à Reuters que moins de 0,1 % des données de la Fifa étaient concernées
Forward Enterprise reste à l’abri
Comme le relève la BBC, la Fifa semble avoir évité le pire, notamment pour son président. Selon le média britannique, aucun document lié à Fifa Forward Enterprise ne figure dans les fichiers volés. Ce projet de Gianni Infantino reste très scruté parce qu’il prévoyait de céder à des investisseurs privés 20 % d’une nouvelle entité chargée d’organiser les tournois de la Fifa, Coupe du monde comprise, pour un montant pouvant atteindre 4,2 milliards de dollars, avant d’être abandonné en juillet face à une vague de critiques.
La Fifa affirme travailler avec les autorités compétentes, forces de l’ordre comprises. Il lui reste à dire qui est concerné par la fuite, mais aussi si les données sont déjà accessibles en ligne, une question à laquelle elle n’a pas répondu.

articles.title: Fuite de données chez 1Password : faut-il changer vos mots de passe de toute urgence ?
articles.text:
1Password a été piraté. Dans une alerte publiée ce 25 novembre, le célèbre gestionnaire de mots de passe révèle avoir été victime d’une intrusion dans ses systèmes internes. L’intrusion a été détectée quelques jours plus tôt. Le 19 novembre, 1Password « a commencé à enquêter sur des indices selon lesquels un attaquant avait obtenu l’accès au compte GitHub professionnel d’un employé ».
Quelles données ont été volées à 1Password ?
Après avoir pris le contrôle du compte, le pirate en a profité « pour accéder au code source et pousser du code malveillant vers des services internes, explique 1Password. Ensuite, l’attaquant a « téléchargé des données administratives concernant nos clients » et « copié du code source de dépôts privés ». Dès que l’attaque a été enregistrée, l’entreprise a « révoqué le jeton volé », remplacé tous ses identifiants internes exposés et fait appel à des experts indépendants.
Parmi les données compromises dans l’incident, on trouve des noms et adresses e-mail, des identifiants de comptes, des dates de création et de dernière connexion. Par ailleurs, des « jetons », présents dans certains liens d’invitation et de récupération de compte, ont aussi été siphonnés. Ces jetons ne donnent pas accès au compte de la victime. Il faut aussi un code envoyé par e-mail, qui passe par précaution de six chiffres à dix caractères, rendant « pratiquement impossible » toute tentative de le deviner.
1Password assure n’avoir trouvé « aucune preuve interne de prise de contrôle de comptes ». L’entreprise ne précise pas combien de clients sont concernés. Pour rappel, 1Password revendique des millions d’utilisateurs et plus de 200 000 entreprises clientes.
Pourquoi vos mots de passe sont encore en sécurité
Le gestionnaire de mots de passe se veut rassurant. Selon la société, « à aucun moment le contenu des coffres des clients n’a été accessible à l’attaquant ». De facto, le pirate n’a pas pu s’emparer des mots de passe stockés par les utilisateurs. Pour résister aux tentatives de vol, 1Password chiffre vos mots de passe directement sur votre appareil. Pour les déchiffrer, il faut votre mot de passe principal et votre « clé secrète », un code de 34 caractères. Or, 1Password ne stocke ni l’un ni l’autre sur ses systèmes, justement pour éviter les attaques.
« Vos secrets sont chiffrés avec des clés que vous seul détenez, nous ne pouvons donc pas y accéder, et un attaquant qui s’introduit dans nos serveurs non plus », souligne l’entreprise.
Non, il ne faut pas changer vos mots de passe d’urgence
De facto, il n’est pas nécessaire de changer tous vos mots de passe. Les coffres, ainsi que les clés qui les protègent, n’ont pas été compromis. Les clients n’ont donc pas besoin de modifier les mots de passe ou les réglages de leur compte. La fuite de données n’est cependant pas sans conséquence.
En effet, une pluie d’attaques phishing risque de déferler sur les personnes concernées. Avec les noms et les adresses e-mail des clients, des pirates pourraient envoyer de faux messages très crédibles, taillés pour subtiliser vos coordonnées bancaires, vos mots de passe ou d’autres données. 1Password appelle à se méfier des « e-mails, SMS ou appels inattendus qui mentionnent 1Password, des invitations ou des tentatives de récupération de compte ». L’entreprise ajoute qu’elle ne « vous contactera jamais pour vous demander le mot de passe de votre compte ou votre clé secrète ».
C’est la première fois que 1Password subit une violation de données. En 2023, l’entreprise avait bien repéré une activité suspecte liée au piratage d’Okta, un prestataire de gestion des identités, mais aucune donnée client n’avait été compromise. L’an dernier, des pirates avaient aussi visé des utilisateurs avec un faux mail d’alerte, mais, là encore, aucune information n’avait réellement été subtilisée.

articles.title: Friedrich Nietzsche, filósofo: “A menudo contradecimos una opinión cuando en realidad solo nos resulta desagradable el tono con que fue expresada”
articles.text:
Friedrich Nietzsche constató que uno de los problemas de las conversaciones es que a veces odiamos la opinión de alguien por el tono que usa. “A menudo contradecimos una opinión cuando en realidad solo nos resulta desagradable el tono con que fue expresada”, escribió en el aforismo 303 de Humano, demasiado humano. Así aparece en el libro.
Se publicó en 1878. Por entonces, el filósofo alemán se alejaba del pensamiento de Schopenhauer. También estaba en peores términos con Richard Wagner (de quien había sido amigo). En la obra analizó las motivaciones de los seres humanos y puso en cuestión la idea de que nuestras opiniones vienen de un proceso racional por encima de los afectos.
Es entonces cuando hace esta observación sobre el tono. Podemos contradecir una opinión aunque realmente lo que desagrade sea el tono de la persona que afirma algo. Es una de las reacciones habituales, aunque Nietzsche no afirma que sean la mayoría de los casos de desacuerdo.
Asoció las creencias con el temperamento. En el aforismo 608 escribió que buscamos inconscientemente principios y doctrinas que se adapten a nuestro modo de ser. Incluso podemos decir después que son estas ideas las que han dado forma a nuestro carácter (aunque Nietzsche dijo lo contrario).
En el 571 escribió también que cuando nos hacen una pregunta, de pronto la primera opinión que tenemos es la que suele ser habitual en nuestro grupo/posición/origen. Para Nietzsche esto no necesariamente era una opinión propia.
Una de las cosas que estudia la psicología es el sesgo de confirmación. Se trata de la tendencia a buscar información que confirme nuestras expectativas previas. Al mismo tiempo, se descarta o no se busca la información que refute esas expectativas. Esto no quiere decir que rechacemos una idea por el tono que utiliza la persona que la presenta.
También escribió sobre la rigidez de las convicciones. En el aforismo 637 escribió que las opiniones nacen de pasiones, pero también que se endurecen gracias a la pereza del pensamiento. En el 483 escribió: “Las convicciones son enemigos más peligrosos de la verdad que las mentiras”. Pueden verse ambos pasajes en el primer volumen.
Qué permite afirmar la psicología sobre el tono
El tono es uno de los aspectos que tenemos en cuenta para interpretar a la otra persona. Existe una famosa regla (la 7-38-55) de Albert Mehrabian. Él mismo explica que sus porcentajes están basados en unos experimentos sobre la comunicación de sentimientos y actitudes. En su explicación de “Silent Messages” aclara que estos porcentajes no pueden aplicarse en otros casos. Por ejemplo, el 38 % no es el porcentaje de contribución de la voz en cualquier tipo de conversación.
Uno de los aspectos que se estudia en psicología es la reactancia ante amenazas a la libertad, como explica una revisión de Christina Steindl y cols. Esto no quiere decir que cuando la otra persona sube el tono dejemos de procesar las palabras que dice.
Por otro lado, hay que tener en cuenta que cuando se cita a algún personaje conocido, es importante ser preciso. En este caso, en el aforismo de Nietzsche se plantea el problema de confundir opinión y desagrado por el tono. Además, en el 484 añade una observación sobre nuestro juicio. Escribió que somos más críticos con el pensador que plantea algo que nos desagrada. Sin embargo, sería más lógico aplicar ese rigor a lo que nos gusta.

articles.title: GTA 6 sur PC à 60 fps ? Pas vraiment, voici où en sont les portages pirates
articles.text:
Aucun nom de projet, pas la moindre fiche technique, mais un chiffre qui suffit à enflammer X : le compte GTA VI NEWS affirme que le portage PC de GTA 6 « a officiellement atteint les 60 fps ».
L’extrait provient en réalité d’une vidéo publiée sur Reddit sans aucune précision sur la version utilisée, la carte graphique ou la définition. Et pour cause : aucun des projets recensés par le site qui suit la course des portages n’approche un tel niveau en jeu.
Des cinématiques, pas du jeu
En regardant la séquence de plus près, on comprend vite le décalage. La vidéo enchaîne uniquement des cinématiques du début de l’histoire avec un compteur à l’écran : on grimpe certes entre 59 et 64 images par seconde lors d’un interrogatoire, et même près de 75 sur l’écran titre du premier chapitre, mais dès qu’une scène de rue s’anime avec un hydravion qui décolle, le compteur retombe entre 44 et 56 fps, avec des chutes vers 31 aux changements de plan.
Le Black Friday est lancé sur l’univers Apple. Sur Back Market, profitez de promotions sur les iPhone, MacBook, iPad, AirPods et Apple Watch. Chaque appareil est soumis à jusqu’à 100 points de contrôle qualité et est livré avec une garantie de 12 mois. De quoi profiter de performances comparables à celles d’un produit neuf.
Des internautes ont aussi repéré plusieurs bugs sur les yeux et l’éclairage. Surtout, ces séquences scriptées ne reflètent en rien la charge réelle une fois la manette en main, quand le PC doit calculer tout le monde ouvert, la circulation et les passants.
En conditions de jeu réelles, la barre reste beaucoup plus basse. Le meilleur résultat mesuré revient à Vice-Tay, qui annonce une médiane de 21,6 images par seconde sur une session de 30 minutes en bateau : c’est obtenu sur une RTX 4090, mais en utilisant le profil graphique allégé de la Xbox Series S.
De son côté, VIctory-7900XTX revendique environ 22 images par seconde dans une rue, au prix de correctifs désactivés par défaut.
Le seuil fixé par les sites de suivi (20 images par seconde tenues sur 30 minutes) n’est donc toujours pas officiellement validé, comme nous le détaillions dans notre présentation de ce tableau des scores.
    Pour aller plus loin
Où en est GTA 6 sur PC ? Ce site suit la course des portages
            
Comment lire ce genre de record
Comme souvent dans cette course effrénée, un compteur d’images par seconde ne veut rien dire sans connaître la configuration, la définition et le type de scène affiché.
Il faut aussi vérifier si la génération d’images est activée : cette technologie fait inventer des images intermédiaires à la carte graphique pour gonfler artificiellement le chiffre, sans rendre le jeu plus réactif. Or la vidéo Reddit ne donne aucune de ces informations.
Ce matin encore, nous démêlions les records de la dernière nuit folle des portages, déjà revus à la baisse dans la foulée. Pour se faire une idée plus sérieuse du matériel nécessaire le jour venu, mieux vaut se pencher sur ce qu’un hacker a fait dire aux PS5 et Xbox.

articles.title: A developer ran 50 agents at once. Then his Mac became the bottleneck.
articles.text:
A developer ran 50 agents at once. Then his Mac became the bottleneck.
As developers move from working with individual AI coding agents to orchestrating dozens of concurrent sessions, the hardware they use to develop software is becoming a potential bottleneck.
In a post on X Monday, a developer named Pranit described how running more than 50 concurrent agent sessions exposed the biggest bottleneck in his development workflow: his Mac.
Vercel CTO Malte Ubl responded that he had encountered the same limitations in his own development workflow.
“No single computer is fast enough to keep up with dozens of agents working on parallel.”
“No single computer is fast enough to keep up with dozens of agents working on parallel,” Ubl writes.
Rather than moving the agents themselves to the cloud, Ubl keeps them running locally and offloads builds and tests to remote sandboxes. Developers can retain their existing tools and workflows without being constrained by the compute capacity of a single machine.
“Dozens of agents can all decide to run a build at the same time,” Ubl tells The New Stack. “They’re competing for the same machine, and everything slows down.”
When agents outrun one machine
Even when model inference runs in the cloud, compilation, dependency management, and test execution initiated by coding agents can place significant demands on local CPU and memory.
Separating agent orchestration from code execution lets developers scale those workloads independently of their local hardware.
Separating orchestration from execution
Developers can install the Vercel Plugin by running npx plugins add vercel/vercel-plugin and then instruct their coding agents to offload builds and tests to remote sandboxes.
One technical challenge of remote execution is maintaining consistency between the local workspace and the sandbox, particularly when agents modify code that hasn’t been committed.
Ubl tells The New Stack that execution begins from a snapshot with dependencies already installed. The current source code, including uncommitted edits and new files that aren’t excluded by Git ignore rules, is then copied to the sandbox. Dependencies persist in the remote environment and are updated when they change.
“You shouldn’t have to commit and push just to test what an agent is working on.”
“You shouldn’t have to commit and push just to test what an agent is working on,” Ubl says.
Unlike conventional CI workflows triggered by repository events, this approach brings remote execution into the development feedback loop itself.
Agents can validate changes before committing, and computationally expensive tasks no longer need to compete for the same local resources.
When remote execution pays off
There is no specific number of concurrent agents at which remote execution becomes more efficient than running builds and tests locally.
The crossover depends on the project’s computational requirements, the frequency of builds and tests, network latency, and the cost of provisioning remote infrastructure.
“You have to weigh the upload, setup time and cloud compute cost against the time saved.”
“You have to weigh the upload, setup time and cloud compute cost against the time saved,” Ubl tells The New Stack. “Warm snapshots help.”
In Seoul, regional image caching brought sandbox startup times down from roughly 3.5 seconds to 1.05 seconds, according to benchmarks published by Vercel.
But spinning up a sandbox is only part of the equation. Developers still have to transfer source files and pay for remote compute. Vercel did not provide benchmarks comparing the total time or cost of running builds and tests locally versus remotely.
Local execution may still make more sense when running a handful of agents on a small codebase. The economics could change when dozens of agents compete for CPU and memory to run builds and tests concurrently.
Local development goes distributed
Remote build systems and cloud-based development environments predate AI coding agents. What’s changing is the number of concurrent workloads an individual engineer can generate.
“As developers run more agents in parallel, I expect this split to become common,” Ubl tells The New Stack.

articles.title: Quantum computers are getting too powerful to check. Scientists have a solution
articles.text:
Quantum computers are getting too powerful to check. Scientists have a solution
- Date:
  November 16, 2026
- Source:
  University of Innsbruck
- Summary:
  Scientists have developed a new way to determine whether quantum simulations can be trusted, solving a growing problem as quantum computers become too powerful for conventional machines to check. Demonstrated on a 51-qubit system, the technique measures uncertainty and provides verifiable error margins that could help unlock the full potential of quantum computing.
- Share:
As quantum computers grow more powerful, researchers face a troubling question: How can they know whether the results are correct when conventional computers can no longer verify them? Scientists have now developed a promising new method that could help overcome this challenge by measuring the accuracy of quantum simulations and identifying how much uncertainty their predictions contain.
The technique uses experimental measurements to reconstruct how a quantum system behaves, then calculates how uncertainties in that reconstruction affect the results. Researchers successfully demonstrated the approach using a quantum simulator with up to 51 qubits in Innsbruck, Austria.
Quantum systems are expected to become capable of solving increasingly complex problems that traditional computers struggle with or cannot handle at all. However, this progress creates a verification problem. When a simulation is small enough, scientists can compare its results with calculations performed on a conventional computer. As quantum systems grow beyond those limits, that direct comparison becomes impractical, making alternative ways to assess their reliability essential.
A New Way to Measure Quantum Computing Accuracy
The breakthrough comes from an international research team led by Tristan Kraft at the Technical University of Munich and Peter Zoller at the University of Innsbruck and the Institute for Quantum Optics and Quantum Information of the Austrian Academy of Sciences, working alongside Barbara Kraus of the Technical University of Munich. The researchers developed a method for experimentally determining how a quantum simulator operates and translating uncertainties in its behavior into measurable limits on the accuracy of its results.
Quantum simulators are specialized physical systems designed to reproduce the behavior of other quantum systems. They are especially useful for investigating situations involving large numbers of interacting particles, where the calculations required can quickly overwhelm even powerful conventional computers.
But quantum experiments are never entirely free from errors. "But no real experiment is perfect," says Tristan Kraft. "Interactions may turn out differently than expected, the system is influenced by its environment, and measurements are also subject to uncertainties."
Rather than assuming a quantum simulator behaves exactly as intended, the new approach examines experimental data to determine what is actually happening inside the system. This allows researchers to identify important interactions and account for disturbances such as fluctuations and noise.
"From this data, we determine the relevant interactions as well as key influences from fluctuations and noise. We then calculate how the uncertainties in this model affect the simulation results," explains Tristan Kraft. "The quantum simulator thus provides not just a single value, but a result with error margins that quantify its accuracy."
Successfully Tested on a 51 Qubit Quantum Simulator
To evaluate the method, the researchers began with a relatively small quantum system containing ten trapped ions. Because conventional computers can still calculate the behavior of a system of this size, the team could test its reconstructed models and calculated error limits against independent measurements.
After this initial validation, the researchers expanded their experiments to a chain of 51 trapped ions. The larger demonstration, carried out by a team led by Manoj Joshi and Christian Roos using an ion trap quantum simulator, showed that the technique could also work with substantially more complex quantum systems.
This represents an important step toward establishing how trustworthy quantum simulation results are, particularly as quantum devices advance into territory where direct verification with traditional computing methods becomes increasingly difficult.
Extending the Breakthrough to More Complex Quantum Systems
The next challenge is to bring the technique to two-dimensional quantum simulators. These systems can model more complicated interactions among particles, making them valuable for exploring quantum physics. At the same time, their growing complexity makes their results particularly difficult to confirm using conventional calculations.
"This is particularly important because classical calculations for such systems become significantly more difficult as the number of particles increases," explains quantum computing pioneer Peter Zoller. "This also makes independent verification of the results increasingly complex, making the question of experimentally determined error limits all the more important."
The researchers are now adapting their method for the newest generation of two-dimensional quantum simulators, which offer improved precision and can investigate systems containing larger numbers of particles.
Looking further ahead, the approach could help scientists establish a more meaningful way to measure quantum advantage, the ability of quantum systems to outperform conventional computers. Instead of comparing machines based only on their processing speed or the size of the problems they can handle, researchers could also examine how accurately each system produces its answers.
"After all, when a classical computer and a quantum simulator tackle the same problem, it's not just a matter of which one delivers a result faster. What's also crucial is which one can solve the problem with a smaller, verifiable margin of error," says Peter Zoller.
This shift could change how progress in quantum computing is evaluated. Future breakthroughs may be judged not simply by how many particles a simulator can model or how quickly it performs calculations, but by its ability to solve increasingly difficult problems with demonstrably reliable results.
The findings were published in Physical Review X. The research received support from the Austrian Science Fund (FWF), the German Ministry of Research, Technology and Space, the European Union, BMW, and other funding organizations.

Si les caméras de surveillance d’extérieur sont utiles pour détecter les visites indésirables, celles prévues pour l’intérieur peuvent notamment permettre de surveiller des animaux de compagnie ou d’être alerté lorsqu’un membre du foyer rentre à la maison. La caméra intérieure orientable Ring 2K, proposée à 34,99 € par Amazon durant le Black Friday, permet ce genre d’usage. Ce modèle intègre une tête motorisée, une définition 2K et un système audio bidirectionnel pour voir et communiquer à distance, le tout depuis un smartphone.
La caméra intérieure orientable Ring 2K est disponible à 34,99 € au lieu de 69,99 € chez Amazon pendant le Black Friday.
Pourquoi choisir la caméra Ring 2K ?
- Pour son orientation motorisée : vous pouvez déplacer la caméra depuis l’application afin d’observer différentes parties de la pièce.
- Pour son suivi automatique : elle accompagne les déplacements d’une personne ou d’un animal détecté, sans ajustement manuel du cadrage.
- Pour son cache de confidentialité : un obturateur intégré permet de désactiver la caméra et le microphone lorsque vous êtes chez vous.
Une caméra qui suit les invités (et intrus) à la trace
La Ring 2K intègre une motorisation qui assure une couverture horizontale de 360° et verticale de 175°, en faisant pivoter son objectif. La caméra diffuse une image de 2 560 × 1 440 pixels et dispose d’une vision nocturne infrarouge, ce qui la rend efficace de jour comme de nuit. Quant à son haut-parleur et son microphone, ils vous permettent de parler à une personne présente sur place en utilisant l’application mobile Ring sur votre smartphone. Elle se connecte au réseau Wi-Fi 2,4 GHz et doit être branchée au secteur pour fonctionner.
Le direct accessible, l'historique sur abonnement
La vidéo en direct et le suivi automatique fonctionnent sans abonnement, ce qui s’avère suffisant pour une surveillance classique. En revanche, si vous désirez pouvoir accéder aux enregistrements des événements, souscrire à un abonnement Ring est obligatoire.
✅ Les points forts
- Vidéo 2K et vision nocturne infrarouge.
- Orientation motorisée et suivi automatique.
- Obturateur désactivant la caméra et le microphone.
❌ Les limites
- Abonnement nécessaire pour visionner les événements enregistrés.
- Alimentation sur secteur obligatoire.
Pour le Black Friday, Amazon réduit de 35 € le prix de la caméra Ring, destinée à un usage à l’intérieur.
La caméra motorisée Ring 2K convient aux personnes qui désirent pouvoir jeter un œil à l’intérieur de leur domicile quand elles le souhaitent, et pouvoir communiquer à distance avec les membres de leur foyer.

articles.title: Mock Service Worker Releases v3.0 with ESM-Only Build, Socket-Based Interception and GraphQL Subs
articles.text:
Mock Service Worker, the API mocking library maintained by Artem Zakharchenko, has released version 3.0, nearly three years after the Fetch-based v2.0 rewrite. The release ships as ESM-only, completes the library's GraphQL story with subscription support, and introduces a socket-based interception algorithm in Node.js that Zakharchenko describes as going as deep into the runtime as JavaScript will allow without recompiling Node.
The headline breaking change is that MSW is now distributed natively as ECMAScript Modules only, with support for Node.js v18 and v20 dropped in favour of v22, v24, and v26. TypeScript 5.9 is now the minimum supported version. Several transitive dependencies have been removed, including graphql (now a proper optional peer), path-to-regexp, picocolors, and statuses. The result is a library tarball that drops from 416KB to 234KB, with type definitions shrinking by half, from 190KB to 90KB.
Alongside ESM, v3.0 introduces granular entrypoints that replace the single msw import with designated paths for each protocol:
import { http } from 'msw/http'
import { graphql } from 'msw/graphql'
import { sse } from 'msw/sse'
import { ws } from 'msw/ws'
GraphQL subscription support, a long-standing community request on the project's tracker, lands in this release. Building on the WebSocket interception shipped previously, subscription handlers can now be defined against a graphql.link() and publish events on demand, closing the gap between MSW's HTTP, WebSocket, and GraphQL coverage.
An experimental defineNetwork API is introduced as the eventual replacement for setupServer and setupWorker. The new primitive splits interception into sources (where traffic comes from) and handlers (how it is answered), allowing teams to replay HAR files, combine custom interceptors, or hand control of request timing to a test runner. The first ecosystem package to expose it directly is @msw/cloudflare, which wraps the API for Workers environments.
The most technically significant change sits in the underlying Interceptors library. Zakharchenko writes that after seven attempts at the problem, the team has moved network interception in Node.js down to the TCP and TLS wraps, the JavaScript bindings for Node's C-level network code. Moving any lower, he notes, would require recompiling Node.js itself. The new architecture supports arbitrary socket-based protocols, with SMTP cited as an early example. Nock already relies on the Interceptors library for its Node.js support.
A GitHub discussion reports failing tests after upgrading, traced to MSW now intercepting the browser-issued OPTIONS preflight requests that previous versions quietly ignored. Separately, a developer in discussion #2771 challenged the earlier decision to deprioritise Jest and JSDOM, arguing that a runner with 46 million weekly downloads warrants a formal breaking-change note rather than a quiet docs change.
In the Node-only space, MSW continues to compete with Nock, fetch-mock, and undici's built-in MockAgent, though as a recent comparison notes, none of those cover both browser and server with a single handler definition.
Teams on v2 should consult the official 2.x to 3.x migration guide before upgrading. Full release notes are available on GitHub.
Mock Service Worker is an open-source, MIT-licensed JavaScript library for mocking network traffic using Service Workers in the browser and runtime-level interception in Node.js. It is used widely for frontend and full-stack testing, and now covers HTTP, WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, and GraphQL including subscriptions.

articles.title: Still waiting for that Black Friday delivery? It may be a scam, warns NordVPN
articles.text:
Still waiting for that Black Friday delivery? It may be a scam, warns NordVPN
NordVPN's experts unveil over 50 fake courier brands selling made-up delivery journeys
- NordVPN uncovered a network of 54 fake couriers, mostly run from China
- They back up fake shops' orders to look like legit shipments
- NordVPN’s next-gen antivirus can block fake shop scams, and it's on sale
Imagine finding a great Black Friday deal for that gadget you needed for ages, placing an order, getting the delivery tracking number, and then never receiving your parcel. This is what has already happened to thousands of shoppers worldwide, according to the latest NordVPN findings.
After analyzing victims' complaints found online, NordVPN’s Threat Intelligence research team was able to uncover a major delivery scam network that counts 54 fake courier companies, mostly run from China.
How the malicious delivery scheme works is simple. Once people place an order on a fake shop, one of the fake courier brands sends them a delivery tracking number. This makes the shops look like legitimate retailers so that, by the time shoppers realize their order isn't arriving, the online retailer stops replying, and they can’t get a refund.
NordVPN's next-gen antivirus suite can help block online scams, including fake shop schemes. It does so by combining threat-intelligence feeds, AI/machine-learning analysis of website traits and URLs, and real-time browsing checks to stop scams before they load.
Even better, it happens to be on sale, with NordVPN's Complete plan starting at the equivalent of $3.99 a month for a two-year plan.
NordVPN Complete: New and improved Black Friday deal
Was: $4.49/month
Now: $3.99/month
While NordVPN Basic has slashed its prices to the equivalent of $2.99 per month, you'll need to upgrade to NordVPN's Complete plan to benefit from the next-gen antivirus tool. Still, you'll get a full security suite at its lowest price in months. This means that, on top of a secure and fast VPN, you'll have:
🕵️ Scam and spam protection
📩 Phishing detection
🦠 Malware defense
⛔ Ad and tracker blocking
Unsure? Try it risk-free with its 30-day money-back guarantee.
How the fake delivery factory works
The goal of this fake delivery factory, NordVPN explains, is to back up fake shops by providing the unfortunate shoppers with tracking numbers and fake parcel journeys so they can look like legitimate retailers.
This improves their chances of cashing in the payments from the card networks. It also helps scammers to win potential disputes over falsely 'delivered' goods.
"Tracking numbers are something we’ve all learned to rely on, and almost always they’re exactly what they seem," says Marijus Briedis, Chief Technology Officer at NordVPN. "This scam takes advantage of that trust. The shop pays for a delivery record for a parcel that was never sent. When nothing arrives, the shop stops replying, and the courier never existed."
NordVPN's researchers managed to find the main platform behind the scheme, which runs on a single server in Hong Kong. The same server was also linked to at least five of the 54 fake courier brands.

How to stay safe
As shoppers are ready to get into the Black Friday frenzy over the weekend, Briedis shares some recommendations to avoid falling victim to similar fake shops and delivery scams:
- Be careful with big discounts on social media. Scam shops copy the names and look of well-known retailers to flood social media feeds with malicious ads. You should always check the brand’s official site directly instead of clicking the ad.
- Check which courier the shop uses before you buy. Trustworthy shops usually ship with well-known carriers and say so. Watch out for red flags like unfamiliar courier names, brand-new websites, missing physical addresses, and free email domains.
- Pay with a method that offers buyer protection. Credit cards and payment services with dispute options give you the best chance of getting your money back.
